item.title: Codex Mobile with Third-Party API: Exploiting the Auth/Model Layer Decoupling
item.description: Got Codex Mobile working with a third-party API relay. The key insight: Auth and Model layers are fully decoupled — ChatGPT handles identity, coding.rexai.top handles inference. Full configuration guide included.

item.title: Ralph Loop and Codex /goal: Why Agents Can Keep Working for Hours
item.description: What keeps coding agents running on long tasks isn't stronger models — it's goal state management and auto-continuation. A breakdown of Ralph Loop and Codex /goal, two engineering approaches to the same problem.

item.title: OpenAI Launches Codex Plugin for Claude Code: Letting Codex Do Code Reviews from Inside Enemy Territory
item.description: OpenAI released the Codex Plugin for Claude Code, letting you call Codex directly from within Claude Code for cross-model code reviews. This article covers the three core commands, installation steps, and design philosophy backed by official documentation.

item.title: Codex + Superpowers AGENTS.md V3: Finally Working for Real
item.description: From V2 to V3: streamlined task routing, fixed sub-agent deadlock bug, added parallel-first prioritization. Shorter context, better results. Full config included.

item.title: You Use AI for Coding, But Have You Ever Used One That Holds Grudges?
item.description: When AI programming tools become goldfish - discussing the context loss pain point and how to make AI remember what you're working on

item.title: Codex 5.3 Tuning Guide: One AGENTS.md to Run Tasks in Parallel and Cut the Fluff
item.description: Configure GPT-5.3-Codex with collab parallelism to run three projects simultaneously, cutting single-task time from 10 minutes to 3. Includes complete config.toml and AGENTS.md templates, ready to copy.

item.title: Codex CLI Ships 12 Versions in 20 Days: Features That Doubled My Coding Productivity
item.description: From v0.86 to v0.97, how did OpenAI's AI coding assistant transform? This article walks you through the most practical new features across these 12 versions—see which productivity boosters you've been missing.

item.title: OpenAI Finally Reveals Codex's Core: The Counterintuitive Design That Shocked Me
item.description: Last night, an OpenAI engineer exposed Codex's agent loop completely. Now I understand why they dare to open source it - Claude Code has met its match.

item.title: Codex CLI 0.86.0 Update: Skill Config, Web Search, Sandbox Elevation & More
item.description: OpenAI Codex CLI, this terminal tool, received major version updates from 0.80.0 to 0.86.0, including SKILL.toml skill config, web search control, sandbox elevation, and headless login. Let's see how to make the most of AI programming.

item.title: Codex Skills Tips: Transform Your AI Coding Assistant into a Pro
item.description: Learn how to configure and use OpenAI Codex Skills to transform your AI coding assistant from a generalist into a domain expert.
